sources.description: Scene appearance: snow-covered mountain slopes, exposed rock, conifers, and a settlement embedded in high terrain. Used for broad surface categories only.
Zone map and geographic context. The map graphic was used only to estimate zone silhouette and relative locations; it is not included in this repository.
Classic zone map image used for coarse digitization of the irregular boundary, terrain belts, water areas, and settlement positions.
Nominal WoW map coordinate frame: 64 by 64 tiles, each 533.333 yards. Converted at 0.9144 meters per yard. This is a grid extent, not a measured playable-zone footprint.

calibration.originDescription: Nominal full WoW 64x64 map-grid frame (34,133.333 yards per side). The actual Dun Morogh playable footprint is an approximate irregular polygon; relative zone and feature positions were digitized coarsely from the published zone map. Physical extents and distances are low-confidence estimates, not in-game survey measurements.

summary: Coarse map-relative pilot, not a surveyed terrain model. The only physical scale is the documented nominal map-coordinate grid. The playable-zone boundary, internal regions, landmark footprints, and pair distances are estimated from a published zone map and are low confidence. Heights are relative elevation bands; exact meters above sea level are unavailable. All generated geometry and materials are original.
